meta.notes: Each test has the Langfuse dataset-item shape: input, expected_output, metadata. metadata holds optional exact-match checks (regex, case-insensitive): must_include_all = every pattern must match; must_include_any = at least one must match; must_not_include = none may match. Run scripts/json_to_csv.py to produce data/mira_eval_dataset.csv for import into n8n (Sheet/Data Table) or Langfuse.

tests.input: Generate a project plan for the AI Adoption Project at ABCDE Ltd. Use the provided project description.
tests.expected_output: A DRAFT project plan for the ABCDE Ltd AI Adoption Project covering 24 weeks (6 months), 2026-03-30 to 2026-09-13, using the 8 phases from the timeline: 1 Project Initiation (wk 1-2: project charter signed off; team structure finalized); 2 Current State Analysis (wk 3-4: current systems audit report; gap analysis report); 3 Use Case Selection (wk 5-6: final list of prioritized use cases with success criteria); 4 Pilot Design (wk 7-10: working prototype models; data pipelines established); 5 Pilot Implementation (wk 11-14: pilot results report; user feedback and performance metrics); 6 Evaluation & Iteration (wk 15-16: updated models and process refinements); 7 Full Deployment (wk 17-22: full production rollout; training sessions completed); 8 Monitoring & Review (wk 23-24: project closure report; recommendations for future scaling). Goals stated ONLY as: reduce delivery delays by 15%, lower operational costs by 10%, improve service responsiveness. Scope: demand forecasting, route optimization, inventory management, customer support. Includes a key-risks section citing register IDs (e.g. R09, R01, R05). No goals or KPIs that are not in the description.

metadata.judge_criteria: 1. The answer is a project plan (not a request for more information). 2. It lists all 8 phases from the timeline by name: Project Initiation, Current State Analysis, Use Case Selection, Pilot Design, Pilot Implementation, Evaluation & Iteration, Full Deployment, Monitoring & Review. 3. It shows the project start date 2026-03-30 and end date 2026-09-13 (or the weeks/dates for each phase that add up to them). 4. It shows at least one milestone or deliverable for each phase. 5. It states the three goals: reduce delivery delays by 15%, lower operational costs by 10%, improve service responsiveness. 6. It has a key-risks section that cites at least 3 risk IDs from R01-R10.
